detailed_descriptions_html.en:
In Memoirium, everything is but sand and stars.

DREAM, DEFY, DECORATE

The realm of dreams throws all reason to the wayside. In one moment, you will find yourself in a simple 21st-century school, and in the next, your eyes will fall upon a castle held together by wax.

Equipment can alter abilities and the entities you can encounter. One armor set may influence how long negative statuses last, while a mask can change how enemies approach you in combat. All items serve a purpose.

Items replenish at certain points in your journey instead of disappearing when consumed, so put them to good use. Collect the same item multiple times to upgrade it, but be warned: even equipment found in the realm of dreams has its limits.

There also appears to be a mysterious location that you have control of in the dream world. Decorate this area of quiet reflection using mementos found throughout your journey across the realm of dreams.

Features

  • A fully interconnected world with multiple paths

  • Personal room to decorate and write in

  • 8 unique dungeons with their own mobs, mini-bosses, and bosses

  • 14 game-changing armors, masks, and off-hand items

  • 25 Keepsakes (consumable items that are replenishable and provide passives)

  • 31 distinct weapons

  • 67 powerful Lullabies (spells)
